props.description: Two-phase animated scene on near-black background with warm amber tones. Phase 1: A phone screen materialises centre-frame; bullet-point 'solutions' type on one by one — 'budgeting apps', 'freelance ideas', 'optimization plans' — each in crisp task-list style, feeling clinical and hollow. Then all items simultaneously dim and dissolve away. Phase 2: The screen clears. A single word fades in at centre in large warm amber type: WITNESS. Below it, a soft heartbeat waveform pulses twice, then stills. The pivot from list-logic to that single word carries the emotional weight of the story.
